confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: Global associations indicate that the partition is related to technical factors, but no set-level associations are significant for C0004 after multiple-testing correction. confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: No strong technical confounding is evident for this set, but global associations warrant caution in interpreting biological findings.
limitations: Global associations are not set-specific and may be driven by other sets.
Set-level tests had limited power due to small set size.
Technical associations are not automatically invalidating.
